items.title_en: Zoho’s Sridhar Vembu warns AI could let one person do the work of 10
items.title_zh: Zoho 的 Sridhar Vembu 警告人工智能可以让一个人完成 10 个人的工作
items.summary_en: Sridhar Vembu cautioned against interpreting this as a prediction that 90 per cent of people working on computers would lose their jobs.
items.summary_zh: Sridhar Vembu 警告不要将此解释为 90% 的计算机工作人员将失业的预测。

items.title_en: Watch: Ambani grandsons steal the show at Jio Platforms’ NSE debut event
items.title_zh: 观看：Ambani 孙子在 Jio Platforms 的 NSE 首次亮相活动中抢尽风头
items.summary_en: In a video, one of the grandsons was seen lying among the flower arrangements in front of the stage. Another video shows him running around on the stage.
items.summary_zh: 在一段视频中，可以看到其中一个孙子躺在舞台前的插花中。另一段视频显示他在舞台上跑来跑去。
